headline: Near-monopoly margins, near its highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $280.78 - $375.51. Currently $344.44, only about 8% below its high.
why_today: Visa continues trading near its 52-week high, backed by a net profit margin of 51.7% - nearly 5x the industry average - on its global payments network. All 40 analysts covering the stock rate it a Strong Buy.
pro_1: Unanimous Strong Buy consensus (40 analysts), average target of $419 implies about 13% further upside
pro_2: 51.7% net margin reflects a near-monopoly payments network almost no other business model can replicate
con_1: PE around 31x is a real premium - the market already prices in continued flawless execution
con_2: Regulatory scrutiny of card network fees remains a persistent long-term overhang
